Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions about renting a trailer from Ridgeway Rentals? Find answers below regarding trailer sizing, allowed materials, delivery, pricing, and booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. General

A disposal trailer is a trailer that we deliver directly to your home, business, or project site. You load the trailer at your own pace, and when you're finished, we pick it up and take care of the disposal..

Choose your preferred rental dates, submit a request, and we'll confirm availability with you. Once your rental is confirmed, we'll deliver the trailer to your location. You fill it at your own pace, and we'll return to pick it up when you're done.

Our rubber-tired trailers are 100% driveway-safe and won't scratch or damage asphalt or concrete like heavy steel roll-off containers can. They are also easier to maneuver into tight residential spots. We recommend requesting your trailer as early as possible, especially for weekends and busy periods. However, we'll always do our best to accommodate last-minute requests based on availability.

No. Submitting a request does not guarantee availability or confirm your rental. A member of the Ridgeway Rentals team will review your requested dates and trailer availability and contact you to confirm your rental.

7. Booking

Use the Book Now form on our website. Select your preferred trailer, drop-off date, and pickup date, then provide your contact and delivery information. We'll review availability and contact you to confirm your rental.

You can provide your preferred delivery date when submitting your request. We'll confirm the delivery details with you once your rental is scheduled.

Yes, you can book a trailer for a weekend. Please provide your preferred delivery and pickup dates when submitting your request, and we'll confirm the details with you once your rental is scheduled.

Yes, we offer same-day delivery for trailer rentals, subject to availability. Please provide your preferred delivery time when submitting your request, and we'll confirm the details with you once your rental is scheduled.

For same-day delivery requests, please contact us directly via phone to confirm availability and scheduling.

We'll contact you to discuss alternative dates or another available trailer that may work for your project. We will do our best to accommodate your needs.

We proudly serve Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville, Milton, Ancaster, Dundas, Stoney Creek, Waterdown, Grimsby, Caledonia, and surrounding communities in Southern Ontario.
